import FreeCAD
import Part
import PartDesign

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("CylinderModel")

# Activate Part Design workbench
FreeCAD.ActiveDocument.recompute()

# Create a Part Design Body
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")

# Create a sketch for the cylinder base
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Add a circle to the sketch with radius 8 mm
# Circle center at origin (0, 0) with radius 8
sketch.addGeometry(Part.Circle(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 1), 8))

# Constrain the circle to be fixed at origin
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Fixed", 0))

# Set up the sketch plane (XY plane by default)
sketch.MapMode = "FlatFace"

# Recompute to ensure sketch is valid
doc.recompute()

# Create a pad (extrusion) of height 32 mm
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
pad.Profile = sketch
pad.Length = 32

# Make sure the body contains the pad
body.addObject(pad)

# Recompute the document
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Document saved successfully!")
print(f"Body: {body}")
print(f"Sketch: {sketch}")
print(f"Pad: {pad}")
print(f"Pad Length: {pad.Length}")

# Verify the shape
shape = pad.Shape
print(f"Shape type: {shape.ShapeType}")
print(f"Volume: {shape.Volume}")
EOF
